summary: Master Google Data Studio with our interactive dashboards training course. Learn to create stunning visualizations and enhance your data storytelling skills.
lede: Interactive dashboard design with Google Data Studio helps professionals who work with reports, KPIs, or performance data turn information into clear, usable visuals. Learners practice connecting and preparing data, choosing charts and scorecards, and building dashboards with filters and calculated KPIs. The course also covers layouts for monitoring, finance, operations, and management reporting, along with sharing and access controls.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with reports, KPIs, or performance data and need to communicate insights clearly. Whether you're in the public sector, private enterprise, or an NGO, this training will enable you to create impactful dashboards.
modules: Introduction to Google Data Studio and Interactive Dashboards
Visualizing Metrics with Charts, Tables, and Scorecards
Making Dashboards Interactive with Filters and Controls
Calculated Fields, Ratios, and Key Performance Indicators
Dashboards for Monitoring, Evaluation, and Program Reporting
Dashboards for Finance, Operations, and Management Reporting
Sharing, Collaboration, and Governance in Google Data Studio
Best Practices, Common Pitfalls, and Dashboard Makeovers
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of data concepts and familiarity with Google Sheets or Excel. No prior experience with Google Data Studio is required.
